query: SELECT t.id,t.data,t.title,t.phase,t.status,t.bot_id,t.kind,m.channel_seq AS "channel_seq?" FROM message_traces t LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.msg_id=t.msg_id AND m.channel_id=t.channel_id WHERE t.channel_id=$1 AND t.msg_id=$2 AND (t.id=$3 OR t.request_id=$3 OR t.data->>'event_id'=$3 OR t.data->>'toolCallId'=$3 OR t.data->>'tool_call_id'=$3 OR ($4::text IS NOT NULL AND (t.data->>'toolCallId'=$4 OR t.data->>'tool_call_id'=$4 OR t.data->'update'->>'toolCallId'=$4))) ORDER BY t.trace_seq LIMIT 1
